section_summary: This section records arrangements for the 1938 visits of the Japanese training ships Taisei Maru and Shintoku Maru and the transports Iroo and Shiriya. State Department correspondence seeks routine courtesies, records approvals and protests, and circulates changes of schedule. Later documents address Taisei Maru’s conduct in port and Shiriya’s delayed arrival at Honolulu, repairs, and request for duty-free entry of repair materials.

subfiles.about: Confirms changed Iroo visits and arrangements for a Manila call.
subfiles.summary: The War Department notified its commands of postponed Los Angeles and Honolulu visits and instructed its Philippine command to extend courtesies for Iroo’s July Manila stop.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Shintoku Maru visit
subfiles.about: Requests approval and courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s visit to Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Describes the training cruise, vessel, complement, and weather-dependent August 22–September 1 schedule.

subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Shintoku Maru at Hilo.

subfiles.title: Request to Interior concerning Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Shintoku Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Notes that weather may affect the sailing ship’s schedule.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor concerning Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Shintoku Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Provides the proposed visit and personnel details.

subfiles.title: Request to Navy concerning Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Requests Navy courtesies for Shintoku Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Seeks customary facilities for the training ship.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury concerning Shintoku Maru

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Shintoku Maru visit request

subfiles.summary: Promises to report whether the proposed visit is approved.

subfiles.title: Labor response concerning Taisei Maru
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: Directs immigration offices to extend courtesies at Portland.
subfiles.summary: Seattle will instruct its Portland office to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Labor response concerning Shintoku Maru
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner, Immigration and Naturalization Service
subfiles.about: Directs Honolulu immigration staff to extend courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Honolulu’s office is asked to welcome the vessel’s personnel.

subfiles.about: Orders customary military courtesies for Shintoku Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Hawaiian Department is instructed to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: War response concerning Taisei Maru

subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area is instructed to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Taisei Maru visit
subfiles.about: States that Navy has no objection to the Portland visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Final approval for Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms approval and customary courtesies for Taisei Maru.
subfiles.summary: Federal departments approve the Portland visit.

subfiles.title: Navy approval of Shintoku Maru visit
subfiles.about: States that Navy has no objection to the Hilo visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Final approval for Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Confirms approval and customary courtesies for Shintoku Maru.
subfiles.summary: Federal departments approve the Hilo visit.

subfiles.title: Oregon governor’s response on Taisei Maru
subfiles.from: Charles H. Martin, Governor of Oregon
subfiles.about: Promises courtesies for Taisei Maru at Portland.
subfiles.summary: Oregon’s governor welcomes the planned visit.

subfiles.title: Treasury customs arrangements for Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Honolulu’s customs collector will arrange facilities for the Hilo visit.

subfiles.title: Treasury customs arrangements for Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies at Portland.
subfiles.summary: Portland’s customs collector will arrange customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Machinists’ protest against Taisei Maru
subfiles.from: L. A. Tronsdale, Willamette Lodge No. 63
subfiles.about: Protests the training ship’s Portland visit.
subfiles.summary: The lodge opposes an official welcome, citing Japanese attacks on Chinese cities and fears of espionage.

subfiles.title: War report on Taisei Maru’s conduct
subfiles.about: Reports missing salute, unreturned boarding visit, and absent U.S. flag.
subfiles.summary: Fort Stevens reported those apparent omissions as Taisei Maru passed; the department noted that the privately owned ship was commanded by a merchant captain.

subfiles.title: Request for Navy comment on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Seeks Navy comment on reported lapses in port courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Forwards War’s account of the salute, boarding visit, and flag.

subfiles.title: State explanation to War
subfiles.from: G. S. Messersmith, for Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Relays Navy’s view that Taisei Maru intended no discourtesy.
subfiles.summary: Explains that merchant vessels need not salute, return boarding visits, or display the visiting country’s flag.

subfiles.title: Navy assessment of Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Explains why Taisei Maru’s actions were not discourteous.
subfiles.summary: Navy identifies the vessel as a nonsaluting merchant ship; boarding visits need not be returned and flag display is optional.

subfiles.title: War acknowledgment of Navy assessment
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the explanation of Taisei Maru’s status.
subfiles.summary: Records receipt of State’s account of Navy’s view.

subfiles.summary: Iroo proposes Los Angeles October 10–13 and Honolulu October 25–27, with customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Notice to Navy of Iroo’s revised schedule

subfiles.summary: Forwards the dates for Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Notice to California governor of Iroo’s revised schedule

subfiles.summary: Announces the revised October itinerary.

subfiles.title: Notice to Labor of Iroo’s revised schedule

subfiles.summary: Circulates the October port dates.

subfiles.title: Notice to Interior of Iroo’s revised schedule

subfiles.summary: Circulates the October port dates.

subfiles.title: Final approval of Iroo’s revised visits
subfiles.about: Confirms approval of Iroo’s October visits.

subfiles.title: War response on Iroo’s October itinerary
subfiles.about: Instructs military commands to extend courtesies to Iroo.

subfiles.title: Labor response on Iroo’s October itinerary

subfiles.summary: Appropriate offices have been notified.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Shiriya visits
subfiles.about: Requests Shiriya’s calls at Los Angeles and Honolulu, including crew landing.
subfiles.summary: The transport seeks petroleum, water, and food.

subfiles.summary: Notes the request for crew landing.

subfiles.title: Request to Interior concerning Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Shiriya’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Gives the refueling and replenishment plans.

subfiles.about: Requests courtesies and consideration of crew landing.
subfiles.summary: Circulates the November port calls.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Shiriya visit request

subfiles.title: Request to California governor concerning Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Shiriya’s Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Describes the proposed port calls and crew-landing inquiry.

subfiles.title: Final approval for Shiriya’s visits
subfiles.about: Approves Shiriya’s informal visits and addresses shore leave.
subfiles.summary: Authorities approve the visits; State interprets crew landing as ordinary shore leave for part of the crew.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Iroo’s itinerary
subfiles.about: States no objection to Iroo’s October visits.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will provide customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on Iroo’s itinerary
subfiles.about: Notifies customs collectors of Iroo’s revised arrival dates.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Los Angeles and Honolulu receive the changes.

subfiles.title: Labor response on Shiriya’s visits
subfiles.about: Notifies immigration offices of Shiriya’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Los Angeles and Honolulu offices receive the plans.

subfiles.title: War response on Shiriya’s visits
subfiles.about: Instructs commands to extend courtesies to Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department are notified.

subfiles.title: Hawaii acting governor’s response on Iroo
subfiles.about: Promises courtesies for Iroo’s Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: The Interior Department forwards the governor’s assurance to State.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Shiriya and shore leave
subfiles.about: Approves Shiriya’s visits and interprets crew landing as shore liberty.
subfiles.summary: Navy has no objection to the informal calls.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on Shiriya and crew effects
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies and explains limits on crew members’ shore articles.
subfiles.summary: Treasury permits crew landing but restricts what crew members may bring ashore duty-free under the customs law.

subfiles.title: Japanese revised schedule for Shiriya
subfiles.about: Changes Shiriya’s Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The proposed calls become November 13–18 and November 29–December 3.

subfiles.summary: Updates the Los Angeles and Honolulu visit dates.

subfiles.title: Notice to Agriculture of Shiriya’s change

subfiles.summary: Updates the November and December port dates.

subfiles.title: Notice to Treasury of Shiriya’s change

subfiles.title: Hawaii acting governor’s response on Shiriya

subfiles.title: Japanese report of Shiriya engine trouble
subfiles.about: Requests approval for Shiriya to remain at Honolulu for repairs.
subfiles.summary: Engine trouble delayed arrival until December 4; repair materials are expected aboard Chichibu Maru on December 16.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for free entry of repair materials
subfiles.about: Seeks duty-free entry of boiler tubes and accessories for Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: Four hundred boiler tubes are due on Chichibu Maru; Shiriya now plans to depart December 16 and repair en route to Japan.

subfiles.title: Request to Treasury for free entry of repair materials
subfiles.about: Requests duty-free admission at Honolulu of Shiriya repair materials.
subfiles.summary: Seeks international courtesy for boiler tubes and accessories arriving on Chichibu Maru.
